HELE.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Helen of Troy Limited for allegedly misleading investors about Project Pegasus, a restructuring initiative. NXTC.summary: Law firm Halper Sadeh LLC is investigating whether NextCure, Inc. obtained a fair price in its proposed merger with Avere Therapeutics, where NextCure shareholders would own only approximately 1.21% of the combined company. The investigation examines potential violations of federal securities laws and breaches of fiduciary duty regarding fair pricing, sales process integrity, and disclosure adequacy.

NXTC.title: NextCure and Avere Therapeutics Announce Merger to Advance Once-Weekly Oral IL-23 Therapy
NXTC.summary: NextCure Inc. announced a definitive merger agreement with privately-held Avere Therapeutics in an all-stock transaction. The combined company will operate as Avere Therapeutics and trade on Nasdaq under ticker 'AVRX'. Avere's lead program AVR-001, an oral IL-23 receptor antagonist, received $320 million in concurrent private investment. The merger is expected to close in H2 2026, with NextCure stockholders owning approximately 1.21% of the combined entity.

GTM.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – GTM
GTM.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: GTM) alleging securities fraud and unlawful business practices. The lawsuit follows ZoomInfo's May 11, 2026 announcement of sharply declined growth outlook and lowered 2026 guidance, which triggered a 32.78% stock price drop. Investors have until August 25, 2026 to request Lead Plaintiff status.

JEF.title: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. is Investigating Jefferies Financial Group Inc. on Behalf of Jefferies Stockholders and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
JEF.summary: Law firm Bragar Eagel & Squire is investigating Jefferies Financial Group for potential securities violations related to its Point Bonita Capital fund's $715 million exposure to bankrupt auto supplier First Brands. The investigation follows SEC inquiry into whether Jefferies adequately disclosed risks to investors. Jefferies stock declined significantly following multiple negative disclosures about the First Brands collapse and subsequent weak earnings reports.

JEF.title: Jefferies Financial Group, Inc. Investigated by the Portnoy Law Firm
JEF.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has initiated a securities fraud investigation into Jefferies Financial Group following significant losses tied to auto supplier First Brands' bankruptcy. Jefferies' Point Bonita Capital fund faced approximately $715 million in exposure to First Brands. The company took a $30 million loss and disclosed declining asset management fees and investment returns in Q2 2026 results, leading to multiple stock price declines totaling over 25% across several disclosure dates.

JEF.title: UNCY: Unicycive Therapeutics Investors with Losses Should Contact Block & Leviton About Securities Fraud Investigation
JEF.summary: Block & Leviton is investigating Unicycive Therapeutics for potential securities law violations related to false or misleading statements about FDA review of its OLC New Drug Application. The company received a second Complete Response Letter on June 30, 2026, citing manufacturing deficiencies, which led to a stock price decline. Investors who have suffered losses are encouraged to contact the firm.

ZENA.title: ZenaTech firma múltiples ofertas para adquirir empresas de topografía y servicios geoespaciales en EE. UU., Canadá y Australia, que se espera que contribuyan C$ 40 millones en ingresos durante los primeros 12 meses posteriores al cierre
ZENA.summary: ZenaTech has signed multiple acquisition offers for surveying and geospatial services companies in the U.S., Canada, and Australia, expected to contribute approximately C$40 million in revenue within 12 months of closing. The acquisitions align with ZenaTech's strategy to transform traditional service businesses into Drones as a Service (DaaS) models, leveraging the rapidly growing drone services market projected to reach $261 billion by 2034.

MGN.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Megan Holdings Limited of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – MGN
MGN.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Megan Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: MGN) alleging securities fraud and stock manipulation. The complaint claims coordinated social media campaigns by fake financial advisors artificially inflated the stock price during the Class Period (September 26, 2025 - March 25, 2026). On March 26, 2026, Megan's stock collapsed 93.4% from $4.24 to $0.28 per share, triggering multiple NASDAQ trading halts. Investors who purchased shares during the IPO or Class Period can join the lawsuit by September 8, 2026.

MGN.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit - BW
MGN.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. (BW) for investors who acquired securities between November 5, 2025, and March 11, 2026, and is investigating claims on behalf of Hyliion Holdings Corp. (HYLN) and Megan Holdings Limited (MGN) investors who suffered losses.

MGN.title: MGN Shareholder Alert: Megan Holdings Limited Securities Class Action Lawsuit - Investors Should Contact SueWallSt
MGN.summary: Megan Holdings Limited (MGN) stock collapsed 93.4% on March 26, 2026, from $5.18 to $0.28 per share, allegedly due to a fraudulent pump-and-dump scheme involving fake financial advisors promoting the stock on social media. A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against the company, its CEO Darren Hoo, CFO Ng Kai Tie, underwriter D. Boral Capital LLC, and auditor WWC, P.C. for failing to disclose the market manipulation and material weaknesses in internal controls. The class period runs from September 26, 2025 to March 25, 2026.

NOC.title: Northrop Grumman Breaks Ground on New Facility to Support Strategic Deterrence and Advanced Aerospace Missions in Utah
NOC.summary: Northrop Grumman broke ground on a new building at its Roy Innovation Center in Utah to support the U.S. Air Force Sentinel ICBM program. The expansion will create hundreds of new jobs and bring the campus to over 1.1 million square feet with capacity for 5,000+ employees. The company directly employs over 11,000 Utahns and supports 46,000 jobs statewide, generating $12.4 billion for the economy.

ENSG.title: ENSG Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Ensign Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: ENSG), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
ENSG.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against Ensign Group, Inc. following a short seller report by Hunterbrook alleging the nursing home operator's business model relies on inadequate patient care and gaming quality metrics. The report claims profits depend on understaffing facilities while routing taxpayer dollars to executives. Ensign shares fell 8.15% on June 8, 2026, following the report's publication.

ENSG.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of The Ensign Group, Inc. - ENSG
ENSG.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating The Ensign Group for potential securities fraud following short reports from Hunterbrook and Muddy Waters Research alleging inadequate patient care, understaffing, quality metric manipulation, and possible Medicare/Medicaid fraud. The allegations triggered significant stock price declines of 8.15% and 2.98% on consecutive trading days in June 2026.

EQPT.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims on Behalf of Investors of EquipmentShare.com Inc. – EQPT
EQPT.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating EquipmentShare.com Inc. for potential securities fraud following a short report by Umibōzu Research alleging undisclosed related-party transactions worth at least $77 million involving company founders. The allegations triggered a 17.55% stock price decline on June 25, 2026, just months after the company's January 2026 IPO at $24.50 per share.

PLNT.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Levi & Korsinsky, LLP Notifies Investors It Has Filed a Complaint to Recover Losses Suffered by Purchasers of Planet Fitness, Inc. Common Stock and Sets a Lead Plaintiff Deadline of September 14, 2026
PLNT.summary: Law firm Levi & Korsinsky has filed a class action lawsuit against Planet Fitness for allegedly providing false and misleading statements about customer acquisition and marketing metrics. The company's updated marketing campaign failed to resonate with its core demographic, leading to slower-than-expected membership growth in Q1 2026. Planet Fitness subsequently slashed full-year growth guidance and withdrew its three-year growth targets. The stock declined 31.19% on May 7, 2026, following the disappointing earnings announcement.

HUBG.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Hub Group, Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – HUBG
HUBG.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Hub Group, Inc. (HUBG) for alleged securities fraud. The lawsuit stems from Hub Group's February 2026 announcement that its Q1-Q3 2025 financial statements were materially misstated due to a $77 million understatement of purchased transportation costs, causing a stock price drop of 18.25%. A subsequent May 2026 disclosure revealed additional material misstatements in 2023 and 2024 annual reports, resulting in another 12.52% stock decline. Investors have until August 28, 2026, to request Lead Plaintiff status.

HUBG.title: DEADLINE ALERT for FUTU, HUBG, PODD, PLAB: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith Reminds Investors of Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Class Actions
HUBG.summary: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith has announced securities fraud class action lawsuits against four publicly-traded companies: Futu Holdings Limited, Hub Group Inc., Insulet Corporation, and Photronics Inc. The lawsuits allege that defendants made false or misleading statements regarding regulatory compliance, financial accuracy, manufacturing controls, and business operations. Investors have until late August and early September 2026 to file lead plaintiff motions.

HUBG.title: Hub Group (HUBG) Securities Class Action Follows Admitted Years-Long Improper Accounting, Executive Ousters, Investor Losses – HBSS
HUBG.summary: Hub Group (HUBG) faces a securities class action lawsuit covering the period April 28, 2023 to May 11, 2026, following revelations of materially misstated financial reports dating back to 2023. The company admitted to premature revenue recognition and understatement of transportation costs. Two senior executives (CFO Kevin Beth and COO Brian Meents) departed on May 27, 2026 as corrective action. The stock declined 18% on February 6, 2026 and another 12.5% on May 12, 2026, wiping out over $890 million in market capitalization.

HUBG.title: SPORTRADAR DEADLINE: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Sportradar Group AG Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important July 17 Deadline in Securities Class Action - SRAD
HUBG.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors in Sportradar Group AG, Hub Group, Inc., and Commvault Systems, Inc. of upcoming lead plaintiff deadlines in securities class action lawsuits. HUBG.title: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Hub Group, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - HUBG
HUBG.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Hub Group, Inc. (HUBG) for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding financial results. The lawsuit claims that Hub Group's financial statements from Q1 2023 to Q3 2025 contained material misstatements related to revenue recognition, operating income, and expense reporting. Investors who purchased HUBG securities between April 28, 2023 and May 11, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with an August 28, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

BYDDY.title: Global Electric Vehicle Market to Reach US$2.74 Trillion in 2026 as Charging and Battery Investment Accelerates
BYDDY.summary: The global EV market is projected to reach US$2.74 trillion in 2026, growing at 9.0% annually, driven by regulatory changes, charging infrastructure investment, and battery supply-chain development. Chinese automakers are intensifying international competition, while battery sourcing and regional manufacturing become strategic priorities. Major players are forming strategic alliances to compete on affordable EVs, software capabilities, and charging networks.

FC.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of AstraZeneca PLC- AZN
FC.summary: Pomerantz LLP announced investigations into potential securities fraud at AstraZeneca following the failure of its Phase-3 CARDIO-Transform trial for Wainua treatment, which caused the stock to drop 5.7%. The firm is also investigating claims against Alibaba Group and Franklin Covey Co.

FC.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Franklin Covey Co. - FC
FC.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Franklin Covey Co. following the company's July 1, 2026 earnings report that missed revenue estimates ($67.81M vs. $68.33M consensus) and significantly lowered full-year guidance to $260-267M from $265-275M. The disappointing results, attributed to geopolitical tensions and execution risks, triggered a 12.85% stock price decline on July 2, 2026.

CELC.title: Celcuity Announces FDA Approval of REVTORPYK™ (gedatolisib) for the Treatment of HR+/HER2-, PIK3CA Wild-Type Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer
CELC.summary: Celcuity announced FDA approval of REVTORPYK (gedatolisib), the first pan-PI3K and mTORC1/2 inhibitor, for treating HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer without PIK3CA mutations. In the Phase 3 VIKTORIA-1 trial, the drug reduced disease progression or death risk by 76% when combined with palbociclib and fulvestrant, and 67% with fulvestrant alone. Commercial launch is anticipated in late Q3 2026.

PODD.title: Pomerantz Law Firm Announces the Filing of a Class Action Against Insulet Corporation and Certain Officers – PODD
PODD.summary: Pomerantz LLP has filed a class action lawsuit against Insulet Corporation for alleged securities fraud. The complaint alleges that Insulet made false statements about its manufacturing controls and failed to disclose defective procedures that created safety risks. Two voluntary medical device corrections were announced in March and May 2026, resulting in significant stock price declines of 6.88% and 5.07% respectively.

PODD.title: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Insulet Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – PODD
PODD.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors who purchased Insulet Corporation securities between February 21, 2025 and May 26, 2026 of the August 31, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline in an ongoing securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that Insulet made false statements regarding defective manufacturing controls and procedures that created safety risks, resulting in investor damages.

PODD.title: DEADLINE ALERT for FUTU, HUBG, PODD, PLAB: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith Reminds Investors of Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Class Actions

The lawsuits allege that defendants made false or misleading statements regarding regulatory compliance, financial accuracy, manufacturing controls, and business operations. PODD.title: Global Blood Glucose Monitoring System Market Size to Reach USD 39.4 Billion by 2035 | Growing at 8.9% CAGR | Industry Trends, Market Share & Forecast – Custom Market Insights
PODD.summary: The global blood glucose monitoring system market is valued at USD 16.8 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach USD 39.4 billion by 2035, growing at a CAGR of 8.9%. Growth is driven by AI-enabled monitoring systems, increasing diabetes prevalence, and rising adoption of home healthcare solutions. Key players include Medtronic, Abbott, Dexcom, and Roche, with recent partnerships like Abbott-Medtronic collaboration to integrate continuous glucose monitoring with automated insulin delivery systems.

PODD.title: PODD DEADLINE: Levi & Korsinsky Reminds Insulet Corporation Investors of Upcoming Securities Class Action Deadline
PODD.summary: Insulet Corporation faces a securities class action lawsuit over defective cannula manufacturing in Omnipod insulin delivery devices. Approximately 7 million Pods were affected by manufacturing defects causing insulin under-delivery. The stock declined from $236 to $146.01 per share following two Medical Device Corrections. Investors who purchased securities between February 21, 2025 and May 26, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 31, 2026.

CPRT.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Copart, Inc. - CPRT
CPRT.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud at Copart, Inc. following the announcement that CEO Jeff Liaw will step down effective July 31, 2026. The news triggered an 8.02% stock price decline, falling $2.45 per share to $28.10 on June 29, 2026.

UP.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Wheels Up Experience Inc. - UP
UP.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Wheels Up Experience Inc. (NYSE: UP). The investigation follows the company's February 2026 announcement of declining full-year 2025 revenue ($736.5M vs $792.1M in 2024) and increased cash burn ($166.3M vs $77.9M in 2024), which triggered a 12.38% stock price decline. Additionally, a planned 1-for-20 reverse stock split announced in April 2026 caused a further 22.51% stock price drop.

GDDY.title: GDDY Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in GoDaddy Inc. (NYSE: GDDY), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
GDDY.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against GoDaddy Inc. for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information to investors. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses on a contingency fee basis.

MKSI.title: MKS Inc. Named in U.S. News & World Report’s 2026-2027 Best Companies to Work For
MKSI.summary: MKS Inc. (NASDAQ: MKSI) has been recognized by U.S. News & World Report as one of the 2026-2027 Best Companies to Work For for the fourth consecutive year in the Manufacturing and Agriculture Industries category. The recognition is based on factors including pay and benefits, work-life balance, job stability, safety, belongingness, and career development opportunities.

FSLR.title: ROSEN, RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages First Solar, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – FSLR
FSLR.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against First Solar, Inc. (FSLR) alleging that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding the company's capacity to manage U.S. tariff policy impacts. The lawsuit claims defendants overstated First Solar's ability to handle tariffs and understated negative impacts from production facility underutilization and relocation efforts on 2026 fiscal year performance. Investors who purchased FSLR securities between February 26, 2025 and February 24, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with an August 24, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

ELWT.title: ELWT Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Elauwit Connection, Inc. (NASDAQ: ELWT), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
ELWT.summary: Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against Elauwit Connection, Inc. (NASDAQ: ELWT) for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information. On February 27, 2026, Elauwit filed an 8-K announcing non-reliance on previously issued interim financial statements due to an error in network construction project revenue recognition during the first nine months of 2025. The stock fell $0.52 per share (6.8%) following the announcement. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.

AMZE.title: Amaze Announces Trading Halt and 1-for-8 Reverse Stock Split
AMZE.summary: Amaze Holdings (AMZE) announced a 1-for-8 reverse stock split effective July 24, 2026, following a NYSE American trading halt due to abnormally low stock prices. The reverse split aims to restore the per-share price to levels appropriate for continued listing on NYSE American. Trading on a split-adjusted basis is expected to resume July 27, 2026 under a new CUSIP number.

COIN.title: HoodDomains Launches .hood: The Identity Layer Turning Wallet Addresses Into Names, Agents, and Payment Rails on Robinhood Chain
COIN.summary: HoodDomains has launched .hood domains on Robinhood Chain, a naming protocol that consolidates wallet addresses, trader profiles, payment endpoints, and AI agents into single human-readable identities. The protocol features x402 payments, embedded wallets, AI agent support, and a native $HD token with deflationary tokenomics and revenue-sharing mechanisms for stakers.

GCGR.title: Prenetics’ IM8 Secures $1 Billion Growth Financing from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund (CVF)
GCGR.summary: Prenetics Global Limited announced a $1 billion growth financing deal with General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund to accelerate IM8's marketing spend. The company raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $210-220 million (from $190-210 million) and projects $300 million annualized run-rate by year-end 2026 and $400+ million in full-year 2027 revenue. IM8, co-founded by David Beckham, has become the fastest-growing premium supplement brand ever, delivering 200,000 servings daily across 43 countries with strong unit economics ($1.44 gross profit return per $1 acquisition spend).

FLEX.title: Halo Fund leads $70M investment into AI-Native Private Banking Platform Flex to accelerate the launch of Flex Global

The round comes six months after a $60 million Series B in December 2025. Flex is expanding globally to 100+ countries with stablecoin payment rails, multi-currency accounts, and private credit solutions. The company has crossed $10 billion in annualized payment volume and is doubling its team to 200 employees.

EDIT.title: Lyora Therapeutics Launches With Seed Funding to Propel Its Biologically Validated Pipeline of Genetic Medicines to Treat Inherited Retinal Diseases
EDIT.summary: Lyora Therapeutics, a new biotech company focused on genetic medicines for inherited retinal diseases, launched with $2.5 million in seed funding. The company's lead programs include LYA-101 for retinitis pigmentosa and LYA-102 for Usher Syndrome Type 2, with plans to submit an IND for LYA-101 within 18 months. The company is led by experienced executives from major genetic medicine firms and co-founded by renowned ophthalmology researchers.

ZTS.title: ZTS Shareholder Alert: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in Zoetis Inc. Securities Lawsuit - Contact SueWallSt
ZTS.summary: Zoetis Inc. faces a securities class action lawsuit covering January 14, 2025 through May 6, 2026, with CEO Kristin Peck and CFO Wetteny Joseph named as individual defendants. The lawsuit alleges they certified misleading statements about companion animal product performance while safety concerns and competitive losses mounted. Zoetis shares fell 21.5% to $87.31 on May 7, 2026 following corrective disclosures. The lead plaintiff deadline is set for July 27, 2026.

ZTS.title: Veterinary Lab Automation Global Market Report 2023 Now Available, Covers Asia-Pacific, North America, Europe, and More
ZTS.summary: The veterinary lab automation market is experiencing robust growth, expanding from $1.26 billion in 2025 to $1.36 billion in 2026 at an 8.4% CAGR, with projections to reach $1.9 billion by 2030. Growth is driven by rising demand for rapid diagnostics, AI integration, companion animal care expansion, and robotic workflow adoption. North America leads the market while Asia-Pacific is positioned for rapid expansion.

NNOX.title: NNOX Deadline Alert: SueWallSt Reminds Nano-X Imaging Ltd. (NNOX) Investors of Securities Class Action Deadline on August 11, 2026
NNOX.summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. (NNOX) investors have until August 11, 2026, to file motions to become lead plaintiffs in a securities class action lawsuit. The action stems from a 24.39% single-day stock decline on April 20, 2026, following disclosure of a $17.5 million asset impairment and closure of the company's South Korean chip manufacturing facility. Lead plaintiffs will oversee litigation regarding alleged misrepresentations about manufacturing efficiency and product demand during the March 31, 2025 to April 17, 2026 period.

NNOX.title: ROSEN, A LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Nano-X Imaging Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – NNOX
NNOX.summary: Rosen Law Firm is urging investors who purchased Nano-X Imaging Ltd. securities between March 31, 2025 and April 17, 2026 to join a class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Nano-X made false statements about operational efficiency and product demand, while concealing poor manufacturing alignment, increased operating expenses, and significant cash burn that would require disruptive restructuring measures.

NNOX.title: ROSEN, A LEADING INVESTOR RIGHTS LAW FIRM, Encourages Embecta Corp. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – EMBC
NNOX.summary: Rosen Law Firm is soliciting investors who purchased shares of Embecta Corp., Nano-X Imaging Ltd., and Lucid Group, Inc. during specified periods to join securities class action lawsuits. The company is advancing its CNS disorder treatment portfolio with FDA-approved products including SUNOSI, AUVELITY, and SYMBRAVO, while progressing multiple clinical trials including Phase 3 FOCUS-2 and FOCUS-3 trials for solriamfetol in pediatric and adolescent ADHD patients.

VEOEY.title: Octave to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 12
VEOEY.summary: Octave Intelligence plc announced it will release its second quarter 2026 financial results on August 12, 2026, followed by a conference call at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The company also announced a renewed strategic partnership with Veolia Environnement to accelerate digitalization of field operations and maintenance.

GTX.title: Garrett Motion to Hold Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call on Wednesday July 29th, 2026
GTX.summary: Garrett Motion Inc. announced it will publish its second quarter 2026 financial results on July 29th, 2026, with a conference call scheduled for 8:30 am EST / 2:30 pm CET. The company will provide a webcast and slide presentation accessible through its Investor Relations website.

BEEM.title: Beam Global Announces Preliminary Second Quarter 2026 Revenue Up More Than 170% From Q1 And More Than 20% Year-Over-Year
BEEM.summary: Beam Global reported Q2 2026 preliminary revenue exceeding $8.5 million, up 170% sequentially and 20% year-over-year, driven by diversified product portfolio expansion and international market penetration. The company achieved 15-18% gross margin improvement and announced $2.7M in future lease savings from manufacturing relocation to Yuma, Arizona, with expectations for additional labor and operational cost reductions.

SNOW.title: Xebia Axis Now Available: An Agentic Data Foundation That Prepares Enterprise Data for AI
SNOW.summary: Xebia announced Xebia Axis, a solution combining AI agents with human engineers to prepare enterprise data for AI deployment. The platform completes data migrations roughly three times faster than traditional approaches while maintaining governance and data quality. It covers the full data lifecycle across six modules and works with major cloud platforms and LLMs.

II investors who received shares in the merger with Blue Owl Technology (NYSE: OTF) on March 24, 2025. IVBIY.title: Spero Therapeutics and Innovent Biologics Announce Exclusive License for SP001 (IBI355), a Phase 2-Ready Third-Generation Anti-CD40L Antibody
IVBIY.summary: Spero Therapeutics and Innovent Biologics announced an exclusive license agreement for SP001 (IBI355), a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody. Spero receives global rights excluding Greater China, with potential milestone payments totaling approximately $1.1 billion plus tiered royalties. Spero plans to initiate a Phase 2 trial in IgG4-related disease in Q2 2027, while Innovent will pursue a Phase 2 trial in Sjögren's disease in China by early 2027.

TLSS.title: Report: Supply Chain Growth Accelerates  Despite Persistent Cost Pressures
TLSS.summary: The Logistics Managers' Index reached 71.1 in June 2026, marking the fastest expansion rate since March 2022. The growth was driven by resilient consumer spending, increased inventory levels ahead of back-to-school and holiday seasons, and potential tariff hedging. However, warehousing and transportation capacity remain tight with rising prices, and future supply chain expansion faces uncertainty due to limited capacity and trade policy concerns.

TRI.title: Crunchafi Launches FRS 102 Section 20 Lease Accounting for UK and Ireland
TRI.summary: Crunchafi has launched FRS 102 Section 20 lease accounting support for UK and Irish accountancy firms, addressing significant changes to lease accounting standards effective January 1, 2026. The platform automates lease calculations, disclosure reporting, and asset roll forwards to help firms transition from manual spreadsheet-based processes. Crunchafi, trusted by over 750 firms globally, brings expertise from supporting ASC 842, IFRS 16, and other lease accounting standards.

IOBTQ.title: Elevara Medicines Appoints Biotech Veteran as CEO
IOBTQ.summary: Elevara Medicines announced the appointment of Dr Mai-Britt Zocca, founder and former CEO of Nasdaq-listed IO Biotech, as its new CEO effective July 1, 2026. Zocca succeeds founder Emma Tinsley, who transitions to Non-Executive Director. The appointment comes as Elevara advances its lead candidate ELV001, a first-in-class oral CDK4/6 inhibitor for rheumatoid arthritis, into Phase 2b clinical trials following a $70 million Series A funding round in October 2025.

PMN.title: ProMIS Neurosciences Reports First Human Evidence of Amyloid-Beta Oligomer Target Engagement by PMN310 at AAIC 2026
PMN.summary: ProMIS Neurosciences announced positive Phase 1a trial results showing PMN310, its lead Alzheimer's drug candidate, achieved dose-dependent reduction of amyloid-beta oligomers in human cerebrospinal fluid. The company demonstrated target engagement in healthy volunteers and plans to present six-month blinded interim data from its Phase 1b PRECISE-AD trial in the coming weeks, with top-line results expected in early Q1 2027.

VEON.title: VEON and JazzWorld Acquire TPL Insurance to Expand Digital Insurance Access Across Pakistan
VEON.summary: VEON's subsidiary Jazz International Holding Limited has completed the acquisition of a 76.33% controlling stake in TPL Insurance Limited for approximately PKR 4.55 billion (~USD 16.4 million). The acquisition integrates insurance into VEON's digital ecosystem in Pakistan, which already includes JazzCash and Mobilink Bank, serving over 100 million customers. TPL Insurance is an AA-rated InsurTech company offering digital motor, health, fire, and property insurance products.

TVGN.title: Tevogen Bio Announces 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders
TVGN.summary: Tevogen Bio Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: TVGN) announced its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders scheduled for August 24, 2026, to be held virtually. The company has set July 23, 2026 as the record date for stockholders and the deadline for submitting stockholder proposals and director nominations. Tevogen continues to focus on its three complementary initiatives: Tevogen Bio (biotechnology), Tevogen.AI (artificial intelligence and technology), and Tevogen Healthcare Services, aimed at improving affordability and accessibility of life-saving medicines.

TVGNW.title: Tevogen Bio Announces 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders
TVGNW.summary: Tevogen Bio Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: TVGN) announced its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders scheduled for August 24, 2026, to be held virtually. Tevogen continues to focus on its three complementary initiatives: Tevogen Bio (biotechnology), Tevogen.AI (artificial intelligence and technology), and Tevogen Healthcare Services, aimed at improving affordability and accessibility of life-saving medicines.

MG.title: MADONNA: CLUB CONFESSIONS NYC WITH MISTR
MG.summary: Madonna returned to New York City to celebrate her No.1 album Confessions II through CLUB CONFESSIONS, an immersive nightlife experience presented in partnership with MISTR, a telemedicine platform providing free HIV prevention and sexual healthcare services. The event, held at Knockdown Center, featured performances by Stuart Price, Honey Dijon, and other artists, drawing celebrities from music, fashion, and entertainment while raising awareness for LGBTQ+ health initiatives.

AMIX.title: Autonomix Medical Enters into $2.6 Million Warrant Inducement Priced At-the-Market Under Nasdaq Rules
AMIX.summary: Autonomix Medical announced a warrant inducement agreement where an investor will exercise outstanding warrants to purchase 428,731 shares at $6.00 per share, generating approximately $2.6 million in gross proceeds. In return, the company will issue new Series D-1 and D-2 warrants with a $5.75 exercise price. The transaction is expected to close on or about July 15, 2026.

CFRUY.title: Edelson Lechtzin LLP Is Investigating Richemont (Compagnie Financière Richemont S.A.) Over Tariff-Driven Price Increases That Were Not Refunded to Consumers After the Supreme Court Struck Down the Tariffs
CFRUY.summary: Law firm Edelson Lechtzin LLP is investigating whether luxury goods company Richemont raised retail prices to pass along tariff costs to consumers and then failed to refund customers after the U.S. Supreme Court invalidated the tariffs on February 20, 2026. The investigation examines potential double recovery by Richemont, which may seek government refunds while keeping price increases from consumers.

MESO.title: Mesoblast Achieves Target of 300 Treated Patients in Pivotal Phase 3 Trial for Chronic Low Back Pain
MESO.summary: Mesoblast Limited announced it has enrolled 300 patients in its MSB-DR004 Phase 3 pivotal trial for rexlemestrocel-L, a cellular medicine for chronic low back pain associated with degenerative disc disease. The trial aims to confirm pain reduction benefits seen in earlier trials, with top-line results expected in mid-2027. The company is proceeding with commercial manufacturing in parallel with the trial, targeting potential peak year revenue exceeding US$10 billion.

ADMA.title: ROSEN, A GLOBAL AND LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages ADMA Biologics, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm – ADMA
ADMA.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors who purchased ADMA Biologics securities between August 9, 2024 and March 25, 2026 of an August 10, 2026 deadline to join a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that ADMA Biologics made materially false statements and failed to disclose undisclosed related party transactions, channel stuffing practices, and inadequate internal controls.

BMI.title: Badger Meter, Inc. Investors Have Until August 3rd to Contact Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Seeking Lead Plaintiff Role
BMI.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Badger Meter, Inc. for allegedly misleading investors about strong financial performance driven by sustainable demand, when results were actually driven by pulling forward customer orders that concealed weakening demand. The company's stock fell over 24% on April 17, 2026, following disappointing Q1 2026 results showing 9% lower sales and significant margin compression. Investors who purchased shares between April 18, 2024 and April 16, 2026 have until August 3, 2026 to apply as lead plaintiff.

LE.title: Lands’ End Reports Inducement Grants under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
LE.summary: Lands' End announced inducement grants to newly appointed Chief Executive Officer Charlie Cole on July 13, 2026. Cole received 109,361 restricted stock units and options to purchase 166,018 shares at $11.43 per share, with a vesting schedule of 25%, 25%, and 50% over three years. The appointment was previously disclosed in a June 30, 2026 Form 8-K filing.

WFRD.title: Weatherford to hold Special Shareholder Meetings on September 3
WFRD.summary: Weatherford International plc announced special shareholder meetings scheduled for September 3, 2026, to vote on the company's proposed redomestication from Ireland to Delaware. The Board unanimously recommends approval, expecting $20-30 million in annual cash savings beginning in 2027. The move aims to simplify the company's organizational structure and support long-term strategy.

CAJPY.title: Canon Announces U.S. Unveiling of Next-Generation varioPRESS iV7 at thINK Ahead 2026
CAJPY.summary: Canon U.S.A. announced the U.S. unveiling of its varioPRESS iV7, a next-generation B2+ sheetfed inkjet press, at the thINK Ahead 2026 conference. The press operates at speeds up to 8,700 sheets per hour and is designed to help commercial printers transition from offset to digital production. The varioPRESS iV7 is expected to be generally available in the United States in Q1 2027.

SBDG.title: SBA Commends U.S. Department of War’s Suspension of CMMC Phase II for Small Defense Contractors
SBDG.summary: The U.S. Department of War has suspended Phase II of its Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) program, originally scheduled for November 2026, following pressure from the SBA and small business stakeholders. The suspension aims to reduce compliance costs (estimated at $388,600-$593,800 per firm) and regulatory barriers that were pushing small defense contractors out of the Defense Industrial Base, while maintaining cybersecurity protections.

TOL.title: Toll Brothers Announces Grand Opening of Torrente in Eagle, Idaho
TOL.summary: Toll Brothers has opened Torrente, a new luxury home community in Eagle, Idaho, featuring single-family homes starting from the mid-$500,000s with floor plans ranging from 1,560 to 4,760 square feet. The community offers premium amenities including a clubhouse, pool, pickleball courts, and walking trails, with convenient access to recreation, shopping, and dining. Quick move-in homes are available with designer finishes.

NAVN.title: Kuehn Law Encourages Investors of Navan, Inc. to Contact Law Firm
NAVN.summary: Kuehn Law is investigating whether officers and directors of Navan, Inc. breached fiduciary duties by misrepresenting growth and revenue opportunities to investors. The company allegedly concealed a 39% increase in sales and marketing expenses ($95 million in Q3 2025) while claiming consistent revenue growth of 33% year-over-year and stable usage yield metrics. The law firm is seeking shareholders who purchased shares prior to the company's November 1, 2025 IPO.

SODI.title: Solitron Devices, Inc. Announces Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Results
SODI.summary: Solitron Devices announced fiscal 2027 first quarter results with net sales increasing 101% to $5.44 million and net income of $0.99 million ($0.46 per share). The company's backlog grew 28% to $23.34 million, with an additional $5.04 million order received post-quarter. However, net bookings declined 48% to $1.45 million. The company is exploring strategic alternatives with an investment banker and expects the next major AMRAAM order in Q3, pending Congressional approval for increased Air Force production.

RGNX.title: Kuehn Law Encourages Investors of Regenxbio, Inc. to Contact Law Firm
RGNX.summary: Kuehn Law is investigating whether officers and directors of Regenxbio, Inc. breached fiduciary duties by providing false or misleading information about the efficacy and safety of RGX-111, a gene therapy for Hurler Syndrome. The firm is seeking shareholders who purchased stock prior to February 9, 2022.

FTNT.title: AI Use in Cybersecurity Jumped From 50% to 78% in a Year. AI-Related Failures Rose Sharply Too. New SANS Institute Survey Reveals a Governance Gap.
FTNT.summary: The 2026 SANS Institute survey reveals rapid AI adoption in cybersecurity (50% to 78% in one year), but governance and workforce structures have not kept pace. While 78% of organizations report AI-enabled attacks and red teaming adoption jumped to 61%, 63% of practitioners report significant AI shortcomings in threat detection. The report highlights a critical gap between deployment speed and proper oversight, with human expertise remaining essential for effective defense.

PEP.title: Sleep Water Enhancers Market Report Just Released, Profiles Unilever, PepsiCo, Suntory, and 17 Other Players
PEP.summary: The sleep water enhancers market is experiencing significant growth, projected to expand from $1.33 billion in 2025 to $2.32 billion by 2030 with an 11.9% CAGR. Key drivers include rising sleep disorders affecting 50-70 million Americans, growing demand for non-pill sleep solutions, and increasing e-commerce penetration. North America currently leads the market while Asia-Pacific is positioned for rapid expansion. Major players include Unilever, PepsiCo, Suntory, and Herbalife, with notable innovations like Natrol's Sleep & Restore line and Foria's acquisition of Ned to strengthen their wellness portfolios.

OMER.title: Omeros Corporation Investigated by the Portnoy Law Firm
OMER.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has initiated an investigation into possible securities fraud at Omeros Corporation following the European Medicines Agency's negative opinion on the company's narsoplimab marketing authorization application on June 26, 2026. The negative regulatory decision triggered a 19.12% stock price decline, dropping from $10.72 to $8.67 per share. The firm is seeking to file a class action lawsuit on behalf of affected investors.

UNCY.title: UNCY: Unicycive Therapeutics Investors with Losses Should Contact Block & Leviton About Securities Fraud Investigation
UNCY.summary: Block & Leviton is investigating Unicycive Therapeutics for potential securities law violations related to false or misleading statements about FDA review of its OLC New Drug Application. The company received a second Complete Response Letter on June 30, 2026, citing manufacturing deficiencies, which led to a stock price decline. Investors who have suffered losses are encouraged to contact the firm.

EDGM.title: EdgeMode fast-tracks growth with Non-Binding Offer from Spark AI Foundry Holdings LLC, for its Ready-to-Build 300 MW AI Data Centre Project in Malpica, Spain
EDGM.summary: EdgeMode, Inc. has entered into a Non-Binding Offer with Spark AI Foundry Holdings LLC for the acquisition of its 300 MW AI data center project in Malpica, Spain. The project is expected to reach Ready-to-Build status by end of 2026 or Q1 2027, with a purchase price of €1,000,000 per MW of IT capacity. The acquisition is subject to due diligence and the project's achievement of required environmental and building permits.

BNTX.summary: The head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 10.5% from 2026-2036, driven by rising cancer incidence, increased adoption of immunotherapies, and the launch of emerging novel treatments.
